text:
Type: upholstered bench with storage lid
Use: a spot to sit and hidden storage at the foot of a bed, in an entryway or by a sofa; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: classic, traditional, contemporary
Materials: soft woven fabric upholstery, padded cushion top, dark turned wooden legs
Colors: medium cool grey fabric, black legs
Shape: long padded box with a piped overhanging lid, small fabric pull tab, four turned legs, low and solid
Feel: soft, cozy, elegant, calm
Goes with: white or grey bedding, dark wood, silver or black accents, light walls; classic or contemporary bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: STOCKSUND
product.description: Storage space under the seat. The lid stays open so you can safely and easily take things in and out.
